title.zh: 异常诊断：Vth 漂移不只看金属
title.en: Diagnosis: Vth drift is not solely a metal issue

subtitle.zh: 均值偏移 / 片内分布 / 局部变异 / 时间漂移
subtitle.en: Mean shifts / within-wafer distribution / local variation / time drift

heading.zh: 01 V_FB 与 Vth 全片同向偏移

body.zh: 同一片晶圆上，V_FB 与 Vth 整体向高或向低偏移。优先检查 WFM 成分与厚度、退火、界面偶极。示意堆栈为 WFM/高 k 介质/界面层/硅衬底；直方图以蓝色表示 V_FB、橙色表示 Vth。
body.en: V_FB and Vth shift together higher or lower across a wafer. First check WFM composition/thickness, annealing, and interface dipoles. Stack: WFM/high-k/interfacial layer/Si; blue histogram denotes V_FB and orange denotes Vth.

heading.zh: 02 片内或器件间离散增大

body.zh: 同片不同位置或不同器件间，Vth 分布变宽、出现双峰等。优先检查膜层连续性、金属晶粒取向、局部缺失、图形尺寸。片内热图颜色从蓝色低值到红色高值。
body.en: Vth broadens or becomes bimodal across positions/devices on the same wafer. First check film continuity, metal-grain orientation, local missing material, and pattern dimensions. The wafer map runs blue-low to red-high.

body.zh: 多次扫描出现 C–V 曲线漂移或迟滞，或随测试历史变化。优先检查固定电荷（Q_f）、氧空位（V_O）、界面态（D_it）、测试历史。图中区分初次与后续扫描。
body.en: Repeated scans show C–V shifts or hysteresis, or depend on test history. First check fixed charge Q_f, oxygen vacancies V_O, interface states D_it, and test history. The figure distinguishes initial and later scans.

heading.zh: 04 Vth 漂移伴随 SS 或迁移率变化
heading.en: 04 Vth shifts with SS or mobility changes

body.zh: Vth 变化同时，SS 变差或迁移率 μ 下降，提示沟道/界面问题。优先检查沟道、界面损伤、器件结构；图示界面损伤、沟道散射增强与器件结构影响（S、D）。
body.en: Vth change accompanied by worse SS or reduced mobility μ points to channel/interface issues. First check channel, interface damage, and device structure; schematics show interface damage, increased channel scattering, and source/drain structure effects.

heading.zh: 05 空气暴露后表面量测变化
heading.en: 05 Surface measurements change after air exposure

body.zh: 样品暴露空气后，表面功函数或 Vth 发生变化。优先检查吸附、原生氧化、参考探针漂移。吸附图中标有 H₂O 与 O₂。
body.en: Surface work function or Vth changes after air exposure. First check adsorption, native oxidation, and reference-probe drift. Adsorbates shown are H₂O and O₂.

heading.zh: 06 首次出现节点与 07 核心判断

body.zh: 结合流程定位异常首次出现的环节：WFM 沉积 → 选择性去除/保留 → 填充 → 退火 → MOSCAP 电学量测 → 器件电学量测。Vth 异常是一种器件表现，需要沿栅堆栈、介质和沟道分支定位根因。
body.en: Locate where the anomaly first appears: WFM deposition → selective removal/retention → fill → anneal → MOSCAP electrical measurement → device electrical measurement. Vth abnormality is a device symptom; trace gate-stack, dielectric, and channel branches to find its root cause.

heading.zh: 08 标签、09 反馈、10 处置

body.zh: 常见标签：n–p 失配、晶圆边缘漂移、双峰分布、C–V 迟滞、退火前后反向变化。量测反馈：C–V 与 I–V、V_FB–Vth 分布、XPS、TEM-EDS、KPFM、晶圆图。
body.en: Common labels: n–p mismatch, wafer-edge drift, bimodal distribution, C–V hysteresis, and opposite shifts before/after annealing. Feedback: C–V and I–V, V_FB–Vth distributions, XPS, TEM-EDS, KPFM, and wafer maps.

body.zh: 处置动作：复测 → Hold → C–V 与 I–V 对照 → 材料/界面分析 → 分片验证。
body.en: Actions: remeasure → hold → compare C–V and I–V → analyze materials/interfaces → validate splits.

body.zh: 未区分 EWF 与介质电荷前，不直接回调单一 WFM 配方。
body.en: Do not directly retune a single WFM recipe before separating EWF and dielectric-charge effects.
